question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Gregory’s experiment at the May Science Fair turned out to be a __facile__ one.
solution:
The Correct Answer is **'Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Given word: Facile. This is an English word which refers to something achieved with little effort or difficulty; easy. ("सहज" or "आसान").

 
 
• **Example: **His explanation of the economic situation of the country was so 'facile' that even a child could understand it.
 
 
 
• **Correct word: **Oversimplified. This term indicates something that has been simplified so much that it is misrepresented or misunderstood. ("अत्यधिक सरलीकृत").
 
 
• **Example: **The 'oversimplified' version of the history might not capture the complexities and nuances of the events.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- **'Oversimplified'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Unequivocal. It refers to leaving no doubt or misunderstanding; clear and unambiguous. ("स्पष्ट").
 
• Option 2: Complicated. It refers to something consisting of many interconnecting parts or elements; intricate. ("जटिल").
 
• Option 3: Spurious. It refers to something not genuine, authentic, or true; not from the claimed, pretended, or proper source; fake. ("जाली").
